summary: A 1936 state road map shows a forest ranger lookout station at Benton; no source describes the lookout site today.

events.note: Shown as a forest ranger lookout station on the 1936 Florida State Road Department map of Benton.

Forest Service decision signed on 28 May 2019 for a special use permit for a 250-foot county communications tower north of Benton Tower Road. The record describes a communications tower, not a lookout.

notes_for_editor: The 1936 map station and the Forest Lookouts index both say Benton, Columbia County, but neither gives a structure name, height, date or design, so they may not describe the same lookout; the story keeps to what each source says. No build date, builder, staffing or fate appears in any source found. The 2019 Forest Service tower is not tied to the lookout in the record; the name Benton Tower Road may hint at an older tower, but that is inference and is left out of the story. Unused leads: the Keuchel p.244 caption (early 1930s lookout tower and weather shed, same book) names no county site; the Florida Memory photo 'Lookout tower - Columbia County, Florida' (floridamemory.com/items/show/37994) returned HTTP 403 and was not read. The brief's agency value is a township/range, corrected above. Verification 2026-10-21: the USFS project record's legal description is Township 1N, Range 17W, S15, one range west of the index's T1N R16E; not used in the story. The story now says the 2019 record does not mention a lookout, which matches its full text.
